We need to determine SMILES of unknown organic molecule given only task description: "Within a laboratory context, you have a sample of an organic molecule. Determine its SMILES notation carefully, using minimal but sufficient analysis." No data provided. We need to use tools to get spectra etc. But we have no initial data. Perhaps the environment has a sample at hand; we can call mass_spectrometry_spectra, proton_nmr_spectra, carbon_nmr_spectra, ir_spectra to get data. Then deduce structure.

We need to minimize cost. Probably start with mass spectrometry to get molecular weight and formula. Then maybe get formula via get_formula_from_smiles? No we need formula from data. But we can get mass spec to see m/z peaks. Let's call mass_spectrometry_spectra.
